name: API Orchestrator - Sample: Alert Rules
description: Pre-configured sample alert rules with Slack and Discord channels, plus setup instructions for webhook URLs.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Sample: Alert Rules installs example api_orchestrator_alert config entities wired to the Slack and Discord alert channels, with README guidance for supplying webhook URLs (via env tokens). A demonstration package for the Alerts submodule. Requires api_orchestrator, api_orchestrator_integration_samples and api_orchestrator_alerts. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
